note: Candidate design roles from 10_PLAN_COMMAND_WIRING_DRY_IMPACT, NOT final component IDs. The audit agent adjudicates canonical names. This concept exercises the components marked exercised=true; reuse_note states what this concept proves about the shared shape.

components.role: A primary area entry point: large editorial panel with title, purpose, live status, and open affordance (never a filter chip).
components.reuse_note: Control Room proves the destination must carry a live status chip + purpose text and route to a manager or category. The shape is shared across all four concepts; only layout (editorial panel vs minimap region vs expandable row vs stream section) differs.

components.role: Attention/continue/recommended callout with exactly one primary action and an optional secondary.
components.reuse_note: Proves a notice carries a consequence string + single clear action + deep-link target. Attention/continue/recommended are the three semantic kinds; styling is theme-driven.

components.role: Full workspace container: left navigation index + continuous content area + exposure control + prose fields.
components.reuse_note: Control Room instantiates it as book-TOC (left vertical index + continuous document). The shell contract (navigation + content + exposure + backbar + crumb) is shared; the navigation metaphor varies per concept.

components.role: Omni-search across settings/categories/managers/destinations with result kinds (setting/category/subcategory/manager/destination) and deep-link jump.
components.reuse_note: Control Room makes search the primary verb on Home. Result rows normalize a kind + label + expl + target. No-results and typo-suggestion are required fixtures.

components.role: Category-level navigation index (book-TOC vertical list with glyphs).
components.reuse_note: Proves category entries carry a glyph + title and expand to subcategories. Active category state is shared semantic state, not DOM class only.

components.role: Syncs left TOC highlight to scroll position in a continuous document; oscillation-free; portable (no DOM measurement as semantic state).
components.reuse_note: Control Room is the canonical stress-test: active-index must derive from a portable section model so the Slint port can replicate it. jump offset (PM.jumpOffset) is a shared primitive.

components.role: Universal setting row: title, explanation, current value/state, default/source, scope, availability, restart/reconnect, help, validation/error.
components.reuse_note: Exercises all 9 value states and exposure levels. The row is the atomic unit every concept must render identically.

components.role: Indicates Default/Recommended/Inherited/Auto/Not-configured/Managed/Custom/Unavailable/Effective-differs.
components.reuse_note: Never represents Auto/Inherit/Not-configured/Disabled as an unexplained empty string. Shared across every value-bearing row.

components.role: Explains why a row/control is unavailable or managed (restart required, reconnect required, changed elsewhere, managed policy, capability missing).
components.reuse_note: Control Room shows restart-required, reconnect-required, changed-elsewhere, and unavailable fixtures; the reason string is shared semantic content.

components.role: Shows requested vs effective value with origin and fallback reason.
components.reuse_note: Control Room is the heaviest user: one shared inspector shape prevents per-manager divergence across five families. The triple (requested/effective/origin) is the shared contract.

components.role: Uniform dedicated-manager shell: header, search/filter, add/connect/create, HealthSummary, resource list, requested/effective inspector, loading/empty/error/managed/unavailable states, logs/diagnostics.
components.reuse_note: Every manager feels designed by the same team. Control Room proves the shell across six C1 managers + the core provider manager.

components.role: Card/table/list of resources (Gists, Personas, Crew templates, Permission rules, Connections, Installations, Models).
components.reuse_note: Shares row/card semantics; only the row kind (MemoryRow vs PersonaCard vs InstallationCard) specializes.

components.role: Projects health: FileSafe floor health, provider installation health, memory rebuild status, connection health.
components.reuse_note: One health shape; FileSafe status is a health summary, never a disable toggle.

components.role: Credential control distinguishing PM-owned secret input, vault reference, CLI-owned auth, PM-direct OAuth, env-backed secret, command-helper secret, non-secret text.
components.reuse_note: Control Room proves the CLI-owned vs PM-direct OAuth boundary must be visible in the field kind. Normal UI never exposes raw tokens; reveal/copy/persist/test differ by type.

components.role: Specialized resource row: half-life/fade indicator, verified/unverified provenance, pin, version history entry, capsule token estimate.
components.reuse_note: Distinct from generic ResourceList row. Fade indicator must never imply deletion.

components.role: Specialized resource card: mission/use boundary, model-facing capsule preview, source/version/provenance, eligible skills, requested capabilities, child-only flag.
components.reuse_note: Enforces behavior-not-authority visually; cannot show authority-granting controls.

components.role: Crew template editor/card: purpose, member roles, persona/capability requirements, allowed provider/account/model candidates, min/max members, adaptive sizing/waves, reserve, write/worktree policy, board topology, diversity/reducer/failure.
components.reuse_note: Orchestrator-owned; requested vs effective members/concurrency projected, not mutated here.

components.role: Ordered last-match-wins rule editor: add/update/reorder/delete, per-tool overrides, per-Persona profiles, wildcard help, ELI5/Expert views, test/dry-run.
components.reuse_note: Reorder is a first-class operation; effective-result sample re-renders on every mutation; FileSafe floor non-bypassable.

components.role: Launches a bounded setup flow (Free Models underlying setup, explicit provider Install, Product Onboarding) and resumes with return context.
components.reuse_note: Control Room exercises the Free-Models-needs-setup and explicit-Install fixtures. Setup is separate from Installation/Deployment and Server Claim/Bootstrap.

components.role: Truthful progress/wait projection for one-shot actions (catalog refresh, reconnect, install/verify, memory rebuild, permission test).
components.reuse_note: Backed by ObservableWork; manager loading does not block the entire Settings workspace.

components.role: Links a completed action to its durable receipt/source disclosure (memory event, permission event, catalog change history, install log).
components.reuse_note: Every mutating action and ObservableWork emits a receipt; ReceiptLink is the shared drill-down.

components.role: Provider family overview: connected state, account/connection/product in use, included usage, models available, setup/repair needs.
components.reuse_note: Default view answers the six canonical questions (connected? which account? included? when included ends? models? needs setup?).

components.role: Account/profile row: nickname, discovered identity, auth source, enabled, priority, sticky-session, usage/quota, last successful connection/generation, health, model visibility.
components.reuse_note: Must not pretend a CLI supports simultaneous profiles; auth_boundary (cli_owned/pm_direct/api_key) visible.

components.role: Installation card: configured command, resolved launcher, actual executable, method, package identity, manager root, host/env, discovery confidence.
components.reuse_note: Advanced detail shows full resolver trace; normal view is one humanized card. Confidence Proven..Unknown; Unknown/Ambiguous is manual-only.

components.role: Model row: favorite, alias, priority, visibility, reasoning/effort, Normal/Fast, modalities, tool/structured-output, context limit, observed availability.
components.reuse_note: Capability evidence retained with freshness; Fast mode and modalities never inferred from names.

components.role: Evidence + freshness for model capabilities (Fast/Normal, effort, modalities, tool support).
components.reuse_note: Control Room exercises the Fast/Normal + effort capability-variation fixture; evidence provenance required.

components.role: Projects included usage, what happens when included usage ends, extra-usage/billing, per-account quota/cooldown.
components.reuse_note: Ties to cmd.usage.refresh / cmd.usage.export (reuse). Usage details may be unavailable while provider is ready (fixture).

components.role: Non-bypassable FileSafe floor status: effective boundary, protected scopes, repair guidance.
components.reuse_note: Projects health only; never offers bypass. Distinct from a generic HealthSummary because it is a hard floor.

summary.note: All 28 components listed are exercised=true by this concept. Sibling-owned components (NotificationDestination, SoundLibraryItem, ThemePreview, CommandEditor, ShortcutRecorder, Lsp/Formatter/ToolResource, StorageHealth, ArtifactRow) are reachable via shared grammar but exercised by their owning concepts.
